died.name: Wat Tyler
died.cause: prior to being killed by officers loyal to Richard II of England
died.last_words: Because they are all under my command, they are sworn to do what I bid them.

died.name: Thomas Campbell
died.last_words: When I think of the existence which shall commence when the stone is laid over my head, how can literary fame appear to me, to any one, but as nothing? I believe, when I am gone, justice will be done to me in this way - that I was a pure writer. It is an inexpressible comfort, at my time of life, to be able to look back and feel that I have not written one line against religion or virtue.

died.name: James K. Polk
died.cause: to his wife, Sarah Childress Polk
died.last_words: I love you, Sarah. For all eternity, I love you.

died.name: Giulio Cabianca and 3 others
died.cause: The 38-year-old Italian racing driver died in a bizarre series of events at the Modena Autodrome after a gearbox failure; unable to stop, Cabianca went off track, struck a spectator and then went through the gate of the Autodrome which was open because of men at work near the track. The car crossed the Via Emilia, collided with several vehicles, then crashed against the wall of a coachbuilder shop. Cabianca was killed, as were three others on the road.

born.name: Edward the Black Prince
born.last_words: I give thee thanks, O God, for all thy benefits, and with all the pains of my soul I humbly beseech thy mercy to give me remission of those sins I have wickedly committed against thee; and of all mortal men whom willingly or ignorantly I have offended, with all my heart I desire forgiveness.

born.name: Edvard Grieg
born.last_words: Well, if it must be so.
